# Iraq Home Expo 2027

> Official website for Iraq Home Expo 2027, an international exhibition for furniture, interiors, home products and residential solutions in Baghdad, Iraq.

Official website: https://iraqhomeexpo.com
Event dates: 12–15 May 2027
Opening hours: 11:00 AM–6:00 PM
Venue: Baghdad International Fair
City: Baghdad, Iraq

## About

Iraq Home Expo 2027 connects international manufacturers, suppliers, brands, distributors, buyers and industry professionals across the home, furniture and interiors market in Iraq.
